title: Decrement-counter action
statement: Let $r$ be one of $m$ Boolean work tapes, let $c_B$ and $n$ be states, and let $rd$ be an optional Boolean read from tape $r$. If a bit is present, the action leaves tape $r$ unchanged and moves its head one cell left, entering $c_B$. If no bit is present, it leaves tape $r$ unchanged and moves its head one cell right, entering $n$.
